body.title: Validate and document the supported harness
body.summary: Run isolated adversarial controls then sequential affected suites; document selectors, runtime setup, budgets, recovery and remaining sibling failures in the audit/index.
acceptanceChecks: All local ac1–ac6 checks have recorded evidence including contention, runtime drift, failed startup, positive/negative probes, interruption and blocked recovery.
No overlapping broad sweeps; broaden only after focused controls pass and prior actors close; report actual pass/fail/cancelled coverage and environment.
Document explicit abrupt-death limits and recovery; preserve sibling failures/security refusals and leave release qualification pending.
Inspect generated sequence source against implementation ordering and verify rendering if available; report unavailable evidence.
Exercise real catchable signals separately from abandoned/replaced-record controls; do not claim all detached descendants can be reclaimed after arbitrary SIGKILL.

tests.name: Sequential focused validation reports actual coverage, remaining failures and closed actors
Documented runtime, selector, budget and blocked-recovery commands match observed behavior
